info.name: Chirpii API
info.description:
Complete Chirpii API collection.

▶ TEST ORDER:
1. Auth → Send OTP
2. Auth → Verify OTP  (auto-saves authToken)
3. Languages → Get All Content Languages  (auto-saves languageId)
4. User → Save Content Language Selection
5. Home → Trending  (auto-saves contentId)
6. Trailers → List Trailers  (auto-saves trailerId)
7. Content & Episodes → List Episodes  (auto-saves episodeId)
8. Then test any other request freely

⚠ All IDs auto-save from real DB responses via test scripts.

variable.description: Auto-set by Get All Content Languages

item.name: 📦 Phase 1 — Login & Language Setup
item.description:
All APIs the frontend developer needs for Phase 1.

Flow:
1. Send OTP
2. Verify OTP  → check hasSelectedLanguages
   • false → show language picker (steps 3–4)
   • true  → go straight to Home
3. Get All Content Languages  → display language tiles
4. Save Content Language Selection  → user picks languages
5. Check Content Language Selection  → confirm & navigate to Home

request.description:
Step 1 — Send OTP to the user's phone.

Change the phone number to match your test number.

exec: console.log('👉 Route user to language selection screen');

request.description:
Step 2 — Verify OTP and get JWT token.

Test script:
• Saves token to {{authToken}} automatically
• Logs hasSelectedLanguages to the console

Response fields:
• token — Bearer token for all auth'd requests
• isNewUser — true on first login
• hasSelectedLanguages:
    false → show language picker (run steps 3–4)
    true  → go directly to Home

item.name: 3. Get All Content Languages  ✅ auto-saves languageId

exec: res.languages.forEach(l => console.log(' •', l.englishName, '/', l.nativeName, '— id:', l._id));

request.description:
Step 3 — Fetch all available content languages to display on the language picker screen.

No auth required.

Each language object:
• _id        — pass this in languageIds when saving the user's selection
• code       — short code, e.g. 'ml'
• englishName — e.g. 'Malayalam'
• nativeName  — e.g. 'മലയാളം'
• imageUrl   — flag / icon URL

Test script saves the first language's _id to {{languageId}}.
To select multiple, copy the IDs from the console log into step 4.

exec: console.log('✅ Languages saved. Now run step 5 to confirm, or go to Home.');

request.description:
Step 4 — Save the languages the user selected on the picker screen.

• {{languageId}} is auto-filled from step 3
• To select multiple languages edit the array:
  ["<id1>", "<id2>", "<id3>"]
• All IDs must be valid _id values from GET /api/languages

exec: console.log('✅ Languages confirmed. Route user to Home.');
console.log('⚠ No languages selected yet. Show language picker.');

request.description:
Step 5 — Verify the user's language selection was saved.

Also used on app launch (after Verify OTP) as an alternative check.

Response:
• hasSelected: true  → navigate to Home
• hasSelected: false → show language picker
• languages: array of selected language objects with full details
Verify the Auth API is reachable.

Sends OTP to the given 10-digit number.
Change the phone number to match a real number in your DB / Twilio test credentials.

Verifies OTP and returns JWT.

Test script auto-saves the token to {{authToken}}.

Response fields:
• token — use as Bearer in all auth'd requests
• isNewUser — true on first login
• hasSelectedLanguages — false = show language picker, true = go to home
Logout the current user. JWT is stateless so the client must discard the token. Test script auto-clears {{authToken}}.

formdata.description: Select any image file (jpeg, png etc.)
S3 folder name — e.g. uploads, languages, banners, profiles

request.description:
Upload any image to S3.

Form fields:
• file — the image file to upload
• folder (optional) — S3 folder prefix, defaults to 'uploads'

Returns:
• url — public S3 URL of the uploaded file
• key — S3 object key

item.name: Get All Content Languages  ✅ auto-saves languageId

request.description:
Returns all active content languages.

Each language has:
• _id — pass this in languageIds when saving user selection
• code — short code e.g. 'ml'
• englishName — e.g. 'Malayalam'
• nativeName — e.g. 'മലയാളം'
• imageUrl — flag / icon

Test script saves the first language's _id to {{languageId}}.
Returns the decoded JWT payload (userId, phone, iat, exp).
Returns full user profile including name, yearOfBirth, gender, appLanguage, contentLanguages, isPremium.

Update name, yearOfBirth, and/or gender.
gender must be one of: male | female | prefer_not_to_say

Sets the app UI language.
Valid values: en | ml | te | hi | ta

Check if the user has picked content languages yet.

Response:
• hasSelected: false → show language selection screen
• hasSelected: true → proceed to home
• languages: array of selected language objects

Save the user's content language preferences.

• Run 'Get All Content Languages' first — {{languageId}} is auto-filled.
• To select multiple languages, add more IDs to the array:
  ["<id1>", "<id2>", "<id3>"]

Update the app UI language only.
Valid values: en | ml | te | hi | ta

To update content language preferences use POST /api/user/content-languages.

item.name: 🔔 User Notifications
item.description: User notification management APIs (List with pagination, Read single, Read All, Clear single, Clear All).

request.description: Fetch user's in-app & push notifications with pagination (`page`, `limit`) and unread count.
Mark a single notification as read (`isRead: true`, `readAt`).
Mark all unread notifications for the user as read.
Clear / remove a single notification for the user.
Clear / remove all notifications for the user.

exec: console.log('✅ contentId saved from trending:', res.data.trending[0]._id, '(' + res.data.trending[0].title + ')');

request.description:
Returns banners, trending, blockbusters, series, continueWatching, forYou, and genres in a single call.
Test script auto-saves the first trending contentId to {{contentId}}.

exec: console.log('✅ contentId saved from banner:', res.data[0]._id, '(' + res.data[0].title + ')');

request.description:
Send the logged-in user's Bearer token to resolve saved content-language preferences. Without a valid token or saved active content language, banners are empty. After changing language selection, refetch this endpoint with the same user token.
Test script saves the first banner's contentId to {{contentId}}.

Get trending content. No auth required. Max limit: 20.
Test script saves the first result's _id to {{contentId}}.

Get active series for the Home screen. No admin token required. Max limit: 50.
Test script saves the first series _id to {{seriesId}}.

Personalised content based on user's content language preferences.
Will return empty if user hasn't selected languages yet.
Returns the user's in-progress content list.

Fetch all active genres for rendering the genre tabs on the Home screen (For You, Drama, Romance, Thriller, Comedy, Horror etc.).

No auth required.
Test script saves the first genre slug to {{genreSlug}}.

Save / update continue watching progress.
• progress: 0.0–1.0 (e.g. 0.45 = 45% through)
• duration: total content duration in seconds
• episodeId: optional — omit for movies

Returns all genres. No auth required.
Test script saves the first genre's slug to {{genreSlug}}.

exec: console.log('✅ contentId updated from genre:', res.content[0]._id, '(' + res.content[0].title + ')');

request.description:
Paginated content for the genre in {{genreSlug}}.
Run 'List All Genres' first to auto-fill the slug.
Gets the metadata of a single series/content item matching contentId. For series, response.content includes seasonStatus and a lightweight seasons array with per-season status and episodeCount.

Gets the list of episodes for the given contentId and seasonId.
• Test script saves the first episode's _id to {{episodeId}}

exec: console.log('✅ episodeId saved:', res.episodes[0]._id, '(Ep ' + res.episodes[0].episodeNumber + ': ' + res.episodes[0].title + ')');

request.description: Gets details for a specific episode by episodeId.
Gets signed S3 stream URL for the episode.
Returns all active coming soon titles (movies/series) for the homepage/slider.
Register the authenticated user to receive notifications when this coming soon title is released.
Unregister the authenticated user from notifications for this coming soon title.

Paginated list of trailers. No auth required.
Test script saves the first trailer's _id to {{trailerId}}.

exec: if (res.url) console.log('Trailer stream URL received, expires in:', res.expiresIn, 'seconds');

request.description:
Get a signed S3 stream URL for the trailer in {{trailerId}}.
Run 'List Trailers' first to auto-fill the ID.
Toggle like on a trailer. Returns the updated total likesCount.
Returns all content items saved to the user's watchlist.

Add a content item to the watchlist.
{{contentId}} is auto-filled after running Trending or Banners.
Remove a content item from the watchlist by contentId.
Check if a content item is in the user's watchlist.
Toggle a content item in/out of the user's watchlist.

exec: console.log('Watch history items:', res.history.length, '/ Total pages:', res.totalPages);

request.description: Paginated watch history. Max limit: 50.

Record a watch event.
• watchedSeconds: how far the user got
• totalSeconds: full episode/movie length (must be > 0)
• episodeId: optional — omit for movies
Remove watch history for one specific content item.
⚠ Deletes the user's entire watch history. No contentId param = clear all.
Get watch progress across all content.
Filter progress to a specific content item.

exec: console.log('✅ contentId updated from search:', res.results[0]._id, '(' + res.results[0].title + ')');

Search content by title keyword.
Test script saves first result's _id to {{contentId}}.

If q is empty → returns recent + trending searches instead.

Called when search input is empty.

Delete a single search history entry.
{{searchHistoryId}} is auto-filled after running 'Get Search History'.
⚠ Clears the entire search history for the user.
Global trending search queries. No auth required.
